nodes.summary: The Kac-Ward matrix with each step multiplied by its direction phase `ons_dirPhase u v`.

nodes.title: Edge-weighted Kac-Ward matrix with direction phases

nodes.summary: The edge-weighted Kac-Ward matrix: the entry from `d₁` to `d₂` is the weight of the torus edge of `d₁` times the turn weight, when `d₂` starts at the head of `d₁`.
nodes.title: Edge-weighted Kac-Ward matrix

nodes.summary: The Kac-Ward matrix: the entry from `d₁` to `d₂` is `x * ons_turnW ω d₁.2 d₂.2` when `d₂` starts at the head of `d₁`, and `0` otherwise.
nodes.title: Kac–Ward matrix of the square-lattice torus

nodes.summary: The sector determinant: the product of `ons_symbolDispersion β` over the momenta `(2π(i + a/2) / L, 2π(j + b/2) / L)`, `i, j < L`, for boundary phases `a, b ∈ {0, 1}`.

nodes.summary: The boundary phase `e^{iπa/L}`, whose `L`-th power is `(-1)^a`.

nodes.summary: The turn weight from direction `μ` to direction `ν`: `1` straight, `ω` for a left turn, `0` for a U-turn, `ω⁻¹` for a right turn.

nodes.summary: The sites `ℤ_L × ℤ_L` of the `L × L` square-lattice torus.

nodes.summary: The total edge-weighted twisted Kac-Ward weight of closed walks of length `n + 1` visiting `e` but not its reverse.

nodes.summary: The total edge-weighted twisted Kac-Ward weight of closed walks of length `n + 1` visiting neither `e` nor its reverse.
nodes.title: Edge-weighted twisted bucket: walks avoiding a dart and its reverse

nodes.title: Trace of a power as a power sum of characteristic roots

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
